title: An ALMA Survey of Submillimeter Galaxies in the Extended Chandra Deep Field South: Source Catalog and Multiplicity
question: What are the interferometric 870um positions, fluxes and multiplicity of the LESS submillimeter sources, and how reliable are earlier single-dish positions and radio/mid-IR counterpart identifications?

what.value: LESS source positions and deboosted LABOCA flux densities

evidence.quote: The beam was centered on the catalogued positions of the LESS sources
used radio and mid–infrared data from the Very Large Array and *Spitzer* to identify potential counterparts to the LESS sources

what.value: Photometric redshift and SFR for ALESS 007.1
VLA 1.4 GHz ECDFS maps (DR1 and DR2)

evidence.quote: Recently, (cite: 2013arXiv1301.7004M) also released another re–reduction of the (cite: 2008ApJS..179..114M) data

recipe.method: Manual CASA calibration (Tsys, WVR, bandpass, phase, flux) then clean with natural weighting, boxes around >5 sigma sources
Iterative pixel-peak (>2.5 sigma) fitting of elliptical Gaussians with MH-MCMC in 2"x2" boxes; 3-parameter point-source and 6-parameter fits; subtract model and repeat
key_parameters: detection threshold 3.5 sigma in good maps

recipe.goal: Completeness, reliability, flux scale and astrometry checks
recipe.method: Fake-source insertion; extraction on inverted maps; ALMA maps convolved to 19" compared with LABOCA; comparison with VLA, MIPS and IRAC positions
MAIN: rms<0.6, axis ratio<2, inside primary beam FWHM, S/N>3.5; supplementary samples with S/N>4; count SMGs per LESS source; compare separations to random simulation

recipe.goal: Test LABOCA position uncertainty and radio/MIR counterparts
recipe.method: Fit offset vs S/N relation (Ivison 2007) for k; compare ALESS SMGs to Biggs et al. counterparts; stack VLA DR2 cutouts

evidence.quote: The median rms noise (at field center) of the maps is $\sigma = 0.4$ mJy beam$^{-1}$
These 99 SMGs are the most reliable SMGs

answer_key.quantity: LESS sources split into multiple MAIN SMGs

evidence.quote: we find that 24 of 69 LESS sources split into two or more MAIN ALESS SMGs
We therefore find that 17/88 ($\sim$19%$\pm$4%) of the LESS sources with high–quality ALMA coverage are non–detections.
completeness of only $\sim$45%, but a reliability of $\sim$80%
